item.description:
• Kit's night cycle now picks up where it left off after your Mac sleeps. A bookkeeping bug meant an interrupted night silently started over from the top every time, so on a Mac that closes its lid mid-dream the cycle could never finish. Found in a beta tester's log, fixed for every Kit.
  • If the nightly cycle stops finishing, Kit says so the moment you open the menu: how many days since one completed, and how many attempts failed in a row. The same two numbers reach the beta roster so we can help before you have to ask, and the beta disclosure grew exactly that one sentence.
  • A fresh Kit is now born on its own runtime: Postgres, Python, and Node running as plain processes on your Mac, no Docker anywhere. Kits already running on Docker stay exactly where they are until they approve the move in the app.
  • The native runtime now ships for Intel Macs as well as Apple Silicon, and every install fetches the runtime built for its own machine.
  • When native setup stops, the screen shows the installer's own explanation instead of a generic snag page. And the false alarm that wrote a scary line into the database log every five seconds is gone, so a real problem stands out.
